b2-pestihumor-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why the Cabaret Was Loved
b2-pestihumor-01.scenario: In a Budapest café, a friend visiting from abroad asks you why Endre Nagy's cabaret of 1907 was so popular with the audience.
b2-pestihumor-01.prompt: Tell your friend why the audience liked the new cabaret, giving a reason that everyone in Budapest knew.
cues: Say that the audience liked the cabaret
Give the reason as something everybody knows
b2-pestihumor-01.target: A közönség szerette a kabarét, hiszen szellemes volt, és társadalomkritika is volt benne.
b2-pestihumor-01.english: The audience liked the cabaret, since after all it was witty and had social criticism in it.
b2-pestihumor-01.canDo: I can say, using hiszen, why Endre Nagy's cabaret was popular in Budapest.

b2-pestihumor-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Jokes in the Shelter
b2-pestihumor-02.scenario: At a museum exhibition in Budapest about the siege of 1944-45, the guide asks you what the wry jokes did for people in the air raid shelters.
b2-pestihumor-02.prompt: Tell the guide what the wry jokes did for the people in the shelters, as something we all know.
cues: Say what the wry jokes helped people to bear
b2-pestihumor-02.target: Az óvóhelyen, ugyebár, a fanyar viccek segítettek elviselni a félelmet.
b2-pestihumor-02.english: In the shelter, as we know, the wry jokes helped people to bear the fear.
b2-pestihumor-02.canDo: I can say, using ugyebár, how people in Budapest used jokes to cope with war and dictatorship.

b2-pestihumor-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Hofi Could Not Say
b2-pestihumor-03.scenario: After a talk about the Mikroszkóp Színpad, a student says that Géza Hofi could say anything on stage. You disagree.
b2-pestihumor-03.prompt: Correct the student: say that Hofi could by no means say everything, and name one subject he could not touch.
cues: Deny that he could say everything, in the strongest way
b2-pestihumor-03.target: Hofi korántsem mondhatott el mindent: a szovjet csapatok jelenléte tabutéma maradt.
b2-pestihumor-03.english: Hofi could by no means say everything: the presence of the Soviet troops remained a taboo subject.
b2-pestihumor-03.canDo: I can say, using korántsem, what Géza Hofi's stage could and could not say under the Kádár system.

b2-pestihumor-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Censors and the Cartoons
b2-pestihumor-04.scenario: In a library exhibition about the satirical weekly Ludas Matyi, a visitor asks you whether the censors noticed every small detail in the cartoons.
b2-pestihumor-04.prompt: Tell the visitor that the censors probably did not notice every small detail.
cues: Name the people who checked the paper
Say it is unlikely that they noticed everything
Mention the small details of the drawings
b2-pestihumor-04.target: A cenzorok aligha vették észre a rajzok minden apró részletét.
b2-pestihumor-04.english: The censors hardly noticed every small detail of the drawings.
b2-pestihumor-04.canDo: I can name the main Hungarian satirical papers and say, using aligha, what they could hardly print.

b2-pestihumor-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Self-Irony
b2-pestihumor-05.scenario: At a university seminar on Hungarian humour, a visiting student asks whether laughing at ourselves is a weakness.
b2-pestihumor-05.prompt: Answer the student: say that self-irony is not self-flagellation but, if anything, a sign of independence.
cues: Say what it is, as a surprising point of view
b2-pestihumor-05.target: Az önirónia nem önostorozás, hanem éppenséggel a szellemi függetlenség jele.
b2-pestihumor-05.english: Self-irony is not self-flagellation, but if anything a sign of intellectual independence.
b2-pestihumor-05.canDo: I can say, using éppenséggel, why self-irony matters in Hungarian humour.

b2-pestihumor-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Century of Pesti Humour
b2-pestihumor-consolidation.scenario: A friend visiting Budapest asks you in a café what Endre Nagy's cabaret, Géza Hofi and István Örkény have in common.
b2-pestihumor-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend what they have in common, with a reason everyone knows.
cues: Say they belong to Hungarian humour
Give a reason as common knowledge
b2-pestihumor-consolidation.target: Nagy Endre kabaréja, Hofi előadásai és Örkény egypercesei is a magyar humor részei, hiszen mindegyikben van önirónia.
b2-pestihumor-consolidation.english: Endre Nagy's cabaret, Hofi's shows and Örkény's one-minute stories are all part of Hungarian humour, since after all each of them has self-irony.
b2-pestihumor-consolidation.canDo: I can outline Hungarian satire from Endre Nagy's cabaret to Géza Hofi and István Örkény.
